decision.reason: The only evidence, [ev-d233a6889a2e], is a one-line changelog entry. It says the HTTP method of the applicationset generate endpoint changed "to avoid route conflicts". It does not give the old or new method, the endpoint path, or which clients (CLI, UI, direct API callers) are affected, so applicability cannot be written. It also does not say what happens to callers that still use the old method, so consequence cannot be written either; the linked PR #20758 or the API diff would be needed.
